scope: S02-T02K source operation runtime health projection

environment.browser: Playwright Chromium against a disposable production frontend image
environment.source: controlled collection-run terminal facts; no external source request or MinIO access

red.contract: pytest collection failed because SourceOperationRuntime did not exist
red.projection: a real PostgreSQL workflow stored a later access_denied failure after a success, while GET /api/sources still returned no runtime observation

green.projection: one read-only window query returns at most the latest success and latest failure for each source and operation
green.state_rules: completed ok, empty or partial is success; failed state or failed outcome is failure; cancelled runs are ignored
green.degraded: a later access_denied failure returned degraded, both UTC observation times and refresh_authorization
green.recovered: a later empty success returned healthy and removed the current recovery action while retaining the historical failure observation
green.isolation: an unobserved operation remained unobserved and static support, rights, pipeline and collection eligibility were unchanged
green.contract: FastAPI OpenAPI snapshot and UmiOpenAPI generated client had no drift; runtime is a required generated capability field
green.dependency_audit: no known Python vulnerabilities; production frontend audit 0
green.frontend: contract, boundary, negative boundary, Prettier and TypeScript/Vite checks passed; 106 modules built
green.browser: 11 Chromium tests passed, including degraded recovery text, unobserved state, Swagger and 390px no-overflow
green.production_compose: required variables fail closed; a complete placeholder environment parsed successfully
green.local_runtime: hotkey-local-main rebuilt from the verified frontend and backend; web 8010 and API 8867 are reachable, all persistent roles are running, readiness is 200, runtime OpenAPI equals the 42-path snapshot and unauthenticated /api/sources returns 401 through the web proxy

cleanup.test_vhost: zero-message hotkey.control queue observed before hotkey_test vhost deletion

limitations: The browser failure response and database runs are controlled evidence; they do not prove that a platform authorization refresh succeeds.
No external platform, existing MinIO instance, real user content, paid service or seven-day observation was used.
Runtime health is a read-only user signal and does not automatically retry, pause or change source admission.
This slice advances FR-007-001 and FR-007-012 but does not complete EV-007-003, EV-007-004 or the full P0 goal.
